div.head: Hn 72.1d
div.ab: Beatus Ieronymus: ‘Homicidas et sacrilegos punire non effusio sanguinis, set ministerium legum’.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 590 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Super Ieremiam 22, auch Ivo Pan. 8, 53; Hn steht Ps.-Egbert zunächst, einem Fränk. Werke, nicht vor 9. Jh.; vgl. Wasserschleben Bussordn. 45; Haddan and Stubbs Councils III 415; Schmitz Bussbücher I 571

Super Ieremiam 22, also Ivo Pan. 8, 53; Hn is closest to Ps.-Egbert, a Frankish work not earlier than the 9th cent.; cf. Wasserschleben Bussordn. 45; Haddan and Stubbs Councils III 415; Schmitz Bussbücher I 571
est ergänzt Tho [aus Ps.-Egb., ed. Anc. laws p. 333]
est supplied by Tho [from Ps.-Egb., ed. Anc. laws p. 333]
Diesen Ps.-Egbert benutzten schon Hirtenbriefe Ælfrics ed. Fehr S. xcvff.—Am Rande spät: Optima distinctio de homicidis, quos morte punire non est effusio sanguinis Rs
This Ps.-Egbert was already used by the Hirtenbriefe Ælfrics ed. Fehr p. xcvff.—In the margin, in a late hand: Optima distinctio de homicidis, quos morte punire non est effusio sanguinis Rs
